name: Sagara Aoi
source:
"I got confused because I have choices. If there weren't, I wouldn't be lost."

She is a fushigi-chan who loves sweets. Basically, she doesn't listen to others. She loves her childhood friend, Roka.

Image color: Emerald green
Image flower: Dahlia, peony

[Translated from [url=https://note.com/nananote07/n/nee97c8c75aa2]Note[/url]]
